Sandbox_ViewpointFixes_VehicleBallistics: Vehicle Ballistics: Vehicle hits: enable
Shots hit the real part of a vehicle (glass, tyres, lights, doors, hood, engine, tank, armour) instead of a random part of that side.
Vehicle Ballistics: Vehicle hits: also in the normal 2D view
Also for shots without True Ballistics (vanilla firing, isometric view). The shot then flies straight along your aim at muzzle height.
Vehicle Ballistics: Vehicle hits: tell the shooter what was hit
A short text over your character, e.g. "Tyre rear left: flat". Each player can switch it off in the mod options.
Vehicle Ballistics: Vehicle hits: damage factor
Multiplies all part damage from bullets.
Vehicle Ballistics: Windshield: hits until it caves in
Laminated glass keeps its holes and stays in place. Hits from a 9 mm until it falls in; stronger rounds count more (rifle about 2x), weaker less.
Vehicle Ballistics: Side and rear windows: shatter chance per hit (%)
Tempered glass usually bursts completely at the first hit. Otherwise a hole with cracks.
Vehicle Ballistics: Lights: break chance per hit (%)
Vehicle Ballistics: Tyres: hits until flat (rifles, slugs, magnums)
Vehicle Ballistics: Tyres: hits until flat (pistols, SMGs)
Vehicle Ballistics: Tyres: hits until flat (.22, .38, single shotgun pellets)
Every pellet of a shotgun counts on its own, so a close shotgun blast usually flattens a tyre.
Vehicle Ballistics: Tyres: how they lose air
Flat at once: after the hits above the tyre is flat. Slow leak: every hole leaks, more holes faster; flat after the time below.
Flat at once
Slow leak
Vehicle Ballistics: Tyres: seconds until flat (slow leak)
Vehicle Ballistics: Tyres: run-flat on armoured vehicles
Vehicles with a run-flat or tyre inflation system (KI5) or wheel armour only lose some condition.
Vehicle Ballistics: Body panels: damage per hit (%)
Doors, hood, trunk, bumpers - for a 9 mm, stronger rounds more.
Vehicle Ballistics: Engine and radiator: damage per hit (%)
Vehicle Ballistics: Fuel tank leaks when hit
Vehicle Ballistics: Shots through glass and doors can hit people inside
Depends on the energy left: rifles go through doors, small calibres often stay in the sheet metal.
Vehicle Ballistics: Vehicle armour: wear per hit
Armour plates and armoured glass (KI5 and other mods) stop most rounds with a scrape and wear down slowly.
Vehicle Ballistics: Shooting from vehicles

In a vehicle with a firearm in hand: hold the right mouse button to aim, left click to shoot (full auto keeps firing). A closed window you shoot through gets a hole or shatters; open (rolled down) windows stay intact. Needs Viewpoint True Ballistics.
Vehicle Ballistics: Shooting from vehicles: the driver may shoot
Vehicle Ballistics: Shooting from vehicles: spread factor
Multiplies the normal spread (skill, moodles, movement).
Vehicle Ballistics: Shooting from vehicles: extra spread for the driver
Vehicle Ballistics: Make side windows of modded vehicles openable
Door windows that cannot be rolled down get the normal Open window / Close window option. Vehicles without an opening animation still look closed, but shots pass.
Vehicle Ballistics: Penetration: enable (True Ballistics)
Rounds can go through walls, doors, furniture, trees and vehicles if their energy is high enough. They fly on slower (less damage) and slightly deflected. Needs Viewpoint True Ballistics.
Vehicle Ballistics: Penetration: zombies behind walls can be hit
Vehicle Ballistics: Penetration: players behind walls can be hit
Off: rounds that went through something pass players behind it.
Vehicle Ballistics: Penetration: material resistance factor
Multiplies every material value below. Higher = fewer penetrations.
Vehicle Ballistics: Penetration: obstacles per round
Vehicle Ballistics: Penetration: extra energy loss (%)
Of the energy left after an obstacle (tumbling, deformation).
Vehicle Ballistics: Penetration: deflection factor
Vehicle Ballistics: Ricochets: enable
Rounds that do not get through hard material at a flat angle can bounce off and fly on.
Vehicle Ballistics: Ricochets: chance factor
Vehicle Ballistics: Ricochets: maximum angle to the surface (degrees)
